subject.title: [Bug] Agent context window fragmentation during concurrent subagent tool calls

question: Should concurrent subagent results remain push-based in completion order, or should OpenClaw add an explicit batch/join mode that waits and presents results in launch order?
rationale: Launch-order buffering changes responsiveness and timeout behavior under the documented orchestration contract, while the report does not demonstrate incorrect run-to-result association.

options.title: Keep completion-order events
options.body: Retain the responsive push model and require a concrete wrong-association trace before changing runtime behavior.

options.title: Add batch/join mode
options.body: Design an opt-in ordered aggregation primitive with explicit partial-failure and timeout semantics.

options.title: Change the default order
options.body: Buffer all concurrent completions by launch order and accept the resulting head-of-line blocking and compatibility change.

recommendation.title: Keep completion-order events
recommendation.body: Retain the responsive push model and require a concrete wrong-association trace before changing runtime behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest recent history across completion handoff, lifecycle, and announce delivery makes this the best available decision-routing candidate.
